title: Ranch Retreat on Acreage in Gilbert - POOL+SPA
description:
Freshly remodeled and designed by Lexi Grace Design. This southwestern single-story ranch home sits on an acre of green grass and mature trees in a quiet neighborhood. 5 bedrooms that comfortably sleep 12 on new Tuft and Needle Mattresses, beautiful bedding and fully furnished for any stay length. Come enjoy beautiful AZ sunsets by the pool*, cuddled up next to the fireplace, or in the spa at night. Thoughtfully designed for an amazing stay experience.

*Pool heating upon request w/ flat fee

 The space 
Fully furnished, great home for families to gather and share amazing memories together. Enjoy our mature citrus trees, flowering shrubs, hot tub, outdoor living, spacious floorplan and quiet, walkable neighborhood with nearby amenities.

Available starting at 3 nights and as a short term rental

 Guest access 
Full Property

 Other things to note 
***Pool heating up to 83 degrees is available upon request with an additional fee, depending on stay length.
***Home is in a quiet neighborhood - please no parties or events of any kind. Thank you!
***Firewood available upon request if you'd like to gather around the flames and stare up at the stars at the end of the day.
***Our property sits on beautiful acreage that receives flood irrigation as part of regular maintenance- it's how our grass is watered. If your booking falls on or near an irrigation date, we’ll notify you at the time of booking so you're fully informed. During irrigation, the rest of the property (including the patio, pool, and spa) remains fully accessible and enjoyable while the irrigation water seeps into the yard which takes about 24 hours.

Irrigation weeks for 2026 (will come one day of the following weeks):
